messages.subject: For Tufan Erginbilgic | Aerospace, power systems and government stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Wray,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Tufan Erginbilgic, Chief Executive Officer.

Rolls-Royce operates at the intersection of aerospace, defence, power systems, governments and the energy transition. That stakeholder environment closely matches the work I lead today in a complex regulated operation.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, including coordination with aviation and other public authorities.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, aviation coordination and industrial stakeholder strategy might support Rolls-Royce's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Rolls-Royce Holdings.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
